goal.title: Daily goal
goal.label: Daily goal in minutes
goal.from_tomorrow: A new daily goal applies from tomorrow. Your day runs until 04:00.
goal.saved: Your daily goal becomes {minutes} minutes from {date}.
goal.overreach: Better start small. 90 or 120 minutes a day is a lot in your first week. Are you sure?

settings.title: Switches
settings.compare_desc: You see the minutes of squad members who turn it on too, and they see yours.
settings.silent_desc: Your squad doesn't see whether you are focusing now. You still count for the squad day.
settings.silent_minor: For 16- and 17-year-olds silent mode is on by default.
settings.squad_name_cards_desc: Only if all members allow it.
settings.no_points_desc: Points, catalogue and bonus messages are hidden. Your points keep running in the background, so you lose nothing.
settings.reminders_desc: At most one email a day, only if your daily goal is still open.

research.title: Research
research.participate_desc: You can opt out any time, without losing points.
research.opted_out: You no longer take part in the research. Your points stay.
research.confirm_title: Stop taking part in the research?
research.confirm_text: You no longer take part in the research. From tomorrow you have the regular bonus rule and you earn points as usual. Your points stay. Signing up again is not possible during the pilot.

institution.title: Institution email
institution.intro: Studying at a university or college? Confirm your institution email address.
institution.fingerprint: We store that you confirmed it, the domain and an encrypted fingerprint of the address, so one address can confirm only one account. We don't store the address itself.
institution.sent: We sent a code to that address.
institution.in_use: This address has already been confirmed by another account. Not right? Let us know via the contact address in the privacy statement; a person looks at it.
institution.domain: This domain is not on the list of pilot institutions.

privacy.title: Privacy and data
privacy.logged: What we record: session times, whether Rewarded was visible on your screen, whether your screen stayed on, signals from your device during a session, your memberships, a hashed IP address, your browser type and a device id. From your first redemption also a hashed phone number. No location, no camera.
privacy.retention: How long: IP hash and browser type 30 days; raw session signals 90 days, then a summary per session; decisions in the audit log 2 years.
privacy.age: We store whether you are 16–17 or 18+. If you are under 18, we also store the day you turn 18, so you then switch automatically.
privacy.download_done: Your data is in a file.
privacy.delete_text: Your account and your data are deleted. Your points lapse and don't come back. Type VERWIJDER to confirm.

terms.title: All terms
terms.ratio: 1 point per minute of a completed session that counted. Fixed, the same for everyone.
terms.cap: Points up to 300 minutes a day. More focus counts for your daily goal, but earns no points that day.
terms.earn_in: Redeeming is possible after 300 minutes of focus, followed by a waiting period of 7 days before your first redemption.
terms.weekly: You can redeem once a week.
terms.catalog: Points give access to the catalogue while stock lasts. Points are not money and do not entitle you to any particular reward.
terms.season: The goal bonus stops at the end of the last exam week of your institution.
terms.night: Sessions that start between 01:00 and 04:00 count without goal bonus.
terms.exam: At most 3 exam days a week; on an exam day your daily goal doesn't count.
terms.verification: A minute counts when Rewarded was visible on your screen. That is all we can see on the web.
terms.challenge: Club prizes and performance challenges are earned: whoever delivers the performance gets the prize. We check winners before handing out.

referral.title: Your personal link
referral.explain: If a friend starts via your link and does three sessions of 25 minutes within 7 days, you both get 150 points. No money. Sharing itself earns nothing. At most half of a reward can come from referral points, and at most 5 friends per month count.
referral.share_text: I'm focusing with Rewarded. Phones down, squad up. Join me?
referral.progress: {name}: {done} of 3 sessions, {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} left
referral.none: Nobody has started via your link yet.
referral.off: The personal link is not switched on right now.

decisions.title: Notifications
decisions.open: A person is looking at this, usually within 3 working days.

reason.no_evidence: We reviewed your session. Everything is fine; your points are released.
reason.pattern_explained: We reviewed your session. Everything is fine; your points are released.
reason.shared_network: We reviewed your session. The shared network explains the pattern; your points are released.
reason.outage_confirmed: We had an outage at that moment. Your session counts as completed after all.
reason.late_log_valid: Your device sent a valid log after all. Your session counts as completed after all.
reason.false_positive: We reviewed your session. Everything is fine; your points are released.
reason.automation: This session ran in a browser controlled by software. That is why it does not count. You can appeal within 14 days.
reason.multiple_accounts: This session belongs to a pattern of several accounts. That is why it does not count. You can appeal within 14 days.
reason.shared_device: This session belongs to a pattern of several accounts on one device. That is why it does not count. You can appeal within 14 days.
reason.unattended_device: The pattern of these sessions fits a device that kept running without you. That is why they do not count. You can appeal within 14 days.
reason.implausible_pattern: The pattern of these sessions does not fit focusing. That is why they do not count. You can appeal within 14 days.
reason.clock_manipulation: Your device's clock was far off from ours. That is why this session does not count. You can appeal within 14 days.
reason.incomplete_evidence: For too large a part of this session we got no signal. That is why it does not count. You can appeal within 14 days.
reason.fraud_confirmed: Your account is blocked: two reviewers found fraud. You can appeal within 14 days.
reason.repeat_offence: Your account is blocked after repeated rejected sessions. You can appeal within 14 days.
reason.blocked_phone_reuse: Your account is blocked: the phone number belongs to a blocked account. You can appeal within 14 days.
reason.other: A decision was made about your session or account.

decisions.appeal_open: Your appeal is in. Another reviewer decides within 5 working days.
decisions.appeal_upheld: A second reviewer agreed with you. Your points are back and the session counts.
decisions.appeal_denied: A second reviewer looked again and reached the same decision: {motivation}
decisions.appeal_text: Explain in your own words why the decision is wrong. A reviewer other than the first one decides.
decisions.appeal_sent: Your appeal is in. You see its status here under Notifications.

blocked.title: Your account is blocked
blocked.intro: You cannot start sessions or redeem anything. You can still appeal, download your data and delete your account.
blocked.rights: You can always download your data or delete your account.
